boundaries.name: ntruShortVectorAssumption
boundaries.obligation: The Falcon accept predicate is an opaque callback; that an accepting (h, salt, s2) implies the holder of the NTRU trapdoor for h authorised the message is assumed, never proved.

boundaries.name: hashToPointOpaque
boundaries.obligation: The hash-to-point map c = H2P(salt, message) and its in-circuit sponge mirror are opaque; no property of the resulting challenge polynomial is assumed or proved.

boundaries.name: hashOpaque
boundaries.obligation: Poseidon is an opaque callback (UtilGadgets.HashEnv). No injectivity or collision resistance is assumed; every fold theorem is about the preimage encoding only.

boundaries.name: pkDigestOpaque
boundaries.obligation: pk_g = Poseidon(IMFK || encode(h)) is an opaque callback; distinct keys are not proved to give distinct digests, nor is a zero digest proved unreachable.

boundaries.name: schwartzZippelChallenge
boundaries.obligation: That agreement of the witnessed product at tau forces coefficient equality is an explicit premise (ProductCheckSound); only completeness is proved.

boundaries.name: fiatShamirRandomOracle
boundaries.obligation: That the in-circuit Poseidon transcript squeezes a tau behaving as a random point is assumed; the sponge is not modelled.

boundaries.name: extensionFieldEvaluation
boundaries.obligation: Horner evaluation is modelled over the naturals; the circuit evaluates in F_{p^2}. The lift between the two is not proved.

boundaries.name: gateLoweringOpaque
boundaries.obligation: No claim that plonky2 gates (arithmetic, range_check, split_le, select, BaseSumGate) lower to the modelled arithmetic.

boundaries.name: fieldRepresentativeAbstraction
boundaries.obligation: Field elements are modelled by non-negative integer representatives; wrap-around is modelled explicitly only where stated (fieldSub).

boundaries.name: vendorFalconParameters
boundaries.obligation: beta^2 = FALCON_SIG_L2_BOUND and the Falcon-512 parameters come from src/falcon_sig/vendor, outside the mapped files; they are pinned as literals only.
